pr_title: No need to wait for green in IndexDiskUsageAnalyzerIT
pr_body:
The test `testFailOnFlush` fails if the number of replicas is one and the cluster has a single data node. We don't need to wait for indices to be green in these tests.

Closes #84789

comments:
@dnhatn, looks like this test was introduced in your recent change: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/84774
Do you mind taking a look? I was able to reproduce locally.

review_comments: Should we wait for yellow before indexing below?

By default we [wait](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/12ad399c488f0cc60e19b5e1b29c6d569cb4351a/client/rest-high-level/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/client/indices/CreateIndexRequest.java#L309-L322) for all primary copies active when creating an index.
